gv_Email_Subject_Success.defaultValue: 'INMCD HIP FTE Refund Process Completed Successfully in the DEV Environment on GBFAC05L'

gv_Query_Select_Refund_Rec.defaultValue:
'SELECT 
	ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY IE.TapeDate DESC) AS ENROLL_ROW_ID, 0 AS BATCH_ID,
	IE.Medicaid_ID AS MEDICAID_ID,
	IE.Maintenance_Type_Code AS MAINTENANCE_TYPE_CODE,
	IE.Maintenance_Reason_code AS MAINTENANCE_REASON_CODE,
	CONVERT(DATETIME, IE.FTE_Eligibility_Start_Date, 112) AS FTE_ELIGIBILITY_START_DATE,
	IE.TapeDate AS TAPE_DATE, 
	CONVERT(DATETIME, IE.FTE_Eligibility_End_Date, 112)  AS FTE_ELIGIBILITY_END_DATE, 
	IE.ImportDate AS IMPORT_DATE,  IE.FTE_Application_ID AS FTE_APPLICATION_ID
FROM
(
SELECT 
	*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY IRC.Medicaid_ID ORDER BY IRC.TapeDate DESC, IRC.ImportDate DESC) AS RANK1
FROM dbo.Indiana_Reporting_Categories IRC
WHERE
IRC.Rpt_Name = 'REFUND'
AND IRC.Rpt_REF_Identifier = 'Y'
AND CAST(IRC.ImportDate AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('9/12/2022' AS DATE) AND CAST('9/12/2022' AS DATE)
--AND IRC.Medicaid_ID = '100003097199' AND IRC.ID <= 147989330
)IRC1
INNER JOIN dbo.Indiana_Enrollment IE
	ON IRC1.Medicaid_ID = IE.Medicaid_ID
	AND IRC1.TapeDate = IE.TapeDate
WHERE
	IE.Maintenance_Type_Code IN ('024') AND IE.Maintenance_Reason_code IN ('03', '14')
                AND LTRIM(IE.FTE_Eligibility_Start_Date) <> ''
	AND IRC1.RANK1 = 1'
